risk_factors: one of [No Risk Identified, Budget Constraints, Competitor Pressure, Economic Uncertainty, Internal Politics, Stakeholder Turnover, Technical Concerns, Timeline Conflict]
competitor_mention: one of [No, Yes]
implementation_readiness: one of [Not Ready, Partially Ready, Ready, Fully Ready]
upsell_opportunity: one of [No, Yes]

competitor_mention: one of [No, Yes]

competitor_mention: one of [No, Yes]
implementation_readiness: one of [Not Ready, Partially Ready, Ready, Fully Ready]
